summary: Provides core analyzers for extracting structure and metadata from Python code elements, including classes, functions, variables, types, decorators, imports, docstrings, and dependencies.
responsibilities: Analyze Python code constructs including classes, functions, variables, type aliases, imports, decorators, docstrings, dependencies, and Pydantic definitions.
Maintain symbol context and dependency resolution information during analysis.
relationships: Analyzers utilize symbol context, dependency resolution, and specialized modules for classes, functions, variables, types, pydantic definitions, imports, decorators, and docstrings to perform code analysis.
design_decisions: Modularized analyzers for different Python language constructs and structures.
